layers.text: Recolour only the dull slate hide: it becomes a deeper, clearer blue, colour #2b5a9a on the lit side with #17325f shadows, a saturated mid-dark blue, not grey and not bright; the dark navy along the back, tail and far leg stays. Do not redraw anything. Keep the amber-orange crest and back spikes, the cream belly, throat and lower jaw, the eyes, teeth, claws, pose, proportions, black outline and style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
